--[[
    KHENZ // Billboard 500K Loop — Anti-Lag Edition
]]

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.ANTI_PURCHASE = false
_G.FPS_GUARD = true
_G.AUTO_UNSPAM = true

local THEME = {
    bg      = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    bg_card = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 32),
    bg_input= Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 44),
    accent  = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 180),
    purple  = Color3.fromRGB(140, 100, 255),
    danger  = Color3.fromRGB(240, 70, 90),
    gold    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 60),
    warn    = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 60),
    text    = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 245),
}

-- FIX 500K (TURUN DARI 1M) + RADIUS AUTO
local FIXED_LOOP = 500000
local FIXED_BATCH = 2500
local CLICK_RADIUS = 5000

local State = {
    spamEnabled = false,
    loopCount = FIXED_LOOP,
    batchSize = FIXED_BATCH,
    successCount = 0,
    blockedCount = 0,
    detectors = {},
    fps = 60,
    fpsHistory = {},
    normalFpsCounter = 0,
    unspamActive = false,
}

local function log(msg)
    print("[KHENZ] " .. msg)
end

-- ============ FPS TRACKER ============
local frameCount = 0
local lastFpsUpdate = tick()

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    frameCount = frameCount + 1
    local now = tick()
    if now - lastFpsUpdate >= 0.5 then
        local elapsed = now - lastFpsUpdate
        local currentFPS = math.floor(frameCount / elapsed)
        State.fps = currentFPS
        table.insert(State.fpsHistory, currentFPS)
        if #State.fpsHistory > 6 then table.remove(State.fpsHistory, 1) end
        frameCount = 0
        lastFpsUpdate = now
    end
end)

local function avgFPS()
    if #State.fpsHistory == 0 then return State.fps end
    local sum = 0
    for _, v in ipairs(State.fpsHistory) do sum = sum + v end
    return math.floor(sum / #State.fpsHistory)
end

-- ============ AUTO UNSPAM ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(1)
        if _G.AUTO_UNSPAM and State.spamEnabled then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            if fps > 50 then
                State.normalFpsCounter = State.normalFpsCounter + 1
                if State.normalFpsCounter >= 5 then
                    State.unspamActive = true
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: 5s")
                    task.wait(5)
                    State.unspamActive = false
                    State.normalFpsCounter = 0
                    log("AUTO UNSPAM: done")
                end
            else
                State.normalFpsCounter = 0
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ AUTO-SCAN BILLBOARD ============
local function detectBillboardDetectors()
    local detectors = {}
    for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if obj.Name:lower():find("billboard") then
            local board = obj:FindFirstChild("Board")
            if board then
                local cd = board:FindFirstChild("ClickDetector")
                if cd and cd:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, cd)
                end
            end
            for _, v in ipairs(obj:GetDescendants()) do
                if v:IsA("ClickDetector") then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if #detectors == 0 then
        for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("ClickDetector") and v.Parent then
                local p = v.Parent
                local gp = p.Parent
                if p.Name:lower():find("board")
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("board"))
                   or (gp and gp.Name:lower():find("billboard")) then
                    table.insert(detectors, v)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return detectors
end

task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        State.detectors = detectBillboardDetectors()
        task.wait(2)
    end
end)

-- ============ SPAM LOOP — 500K ============
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        if State.spamEnabled and #State.detectors > 0 and not State.unspamActive then
            local fps = avgFPS()
            local curLoop = FIXED_LOOP
            local curBatch = FIXED_BATCH

            if _G.FPS_GUARD then
                if fps < 15 then
                    task.wait(1)
                    local waitCount = 0
                    while avgFPS() < 20 and waitCount < 10 do
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        waitCount = waitCount + 1
                    end
                elseif fps < 30 then
                    curLoop = 50000
                    curBatch = 250
                elseif fps < 50 then
                    curLoop = 250000
                    curBatch = 1000
                end
            end

            local batch = 0
            for i = 1, curLoop do
                if not State.spamEnabled or State.unspamActive then break end
                if i % 1000 == 0 and _G.FPS_GUARD and avgFPS() < 15 then break end

                for _, cd in ipairs(State.detectors) do
                    pcall(function()
                        fireclickdetector(cd, CLICK_RADIUS, 1)
                    end)
                    State.successCount = State.successCount + 1
                    batch = batch + 1
                end

                if batch >= curBatch then
                    batch = 0
                    task.wait()
                end
            end

            task.wait()
        else
            task.wait(0.05)
        end
    end
end)

-- ============ ANTI PURCHASE ============
local function disablePrompt()
    pcall(function()
        local prompt = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("PurchasePromptApp")
        if prompt and prompt.Enabled then
            prompt.Enabled = false
            State.blockedCount = State.blockedCount + 1
        end
    end)
    pcall(function()
        local overlay = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("FoundationOverlay")
        if overlay and overlay.Enabled then
            overlay.Enabled = false
        end
    end)
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE then disablePrompt() end
end)

CoreGui.ChildAdded:Connect(function(ins)
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE and (ins.Name == "PurchasePromptApp" or ins.Name == "FoundationOverlay") then
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function() ins.Enabled = false end)
    end
end)

CoreGui.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(ins)
    if _G.ANTI_PURCHASE and (ins.Name == "PurchasePromptApp" or ins.Name == "FoundationOverlay") then
        task.wait(0.05)
        pcall(function() ins.Enabled = false end)
    end
end)

-- ============ GUI ============
if CoreGui:FindFirstChild("KHENZ_Billboard") then CoreGui.KHENZ_Billboard:Destroy() end

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "KHENZ_Billboard"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.DisplayOrder = 9999
pcall(function() gui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not gui.Parent then gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild("PlayerGui") end

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 280)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0.5, -140)
main.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.bg

main.Active = true
main.Parent = gui

stroke.Parent = main

local topbar = Instance.new("Frame")
topbar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28)
topbar.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.bg_card
topbar.BorderSizePixel = 0
topbar.Active = true
topbar.Parent = main
Instance.new("UICorner", topbar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local titleLbl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLbl.Size = UDim2.new(1, -60, 1, 0)
titleLbl.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
titleLbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLbl.Text = "BILLBOARD 500K"
titleLbl.TextColor3 = THEME.danger
titleLbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
titleLbl.TextSize = 11
titleLbl.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLbl.Parent = topbar

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 20)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0.5, -10)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.bg_input
closeBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.danger
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 11
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.Parent = topbar
Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() gui.Enabled = false end)

local dragging, dragStart, startPos
topbar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = main.Position
    end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1

end)
UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
                     or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local d = input.Position - dragStart
        main.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + d.X,
                                  startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
    end

body.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 32)
body.BackgroundTransparency = 1

task.spawn(function()
    while statusLbl.Parent do
        task.wait(0.5)
        local fps = avgFPS()
        local status = ""
        if State.unspamActive then status = " ⏸"
        elseif fps < 30 then status = " ⚠" end

        statusLbl.Text = string.format(
            "spam: %d | block: %d\nFPS: %d | loop: 500K%s\nradius: %d",
            State.successCount, State.blockedCount, fps, status, CLICK_RADIUS
        )
    end
end)

    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold

    b.Parent = btnHolder
    Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

        local c = b:GetAttribute("CurrentColor") or color
        TweenService:Create(b, TweenInfo.new(0.1), { BackgroundColor3 = c }):Play()
    end)
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() callback(b) end)
    return b
end

-- Sistem pembersihan ultra pantas, pemadaman Baseplate, dan jatuhan graviti rawak supaya pemain tidak bertindih di atas kepala.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- KONFIGURASI BACKROOMS
local CHUNK_SIZE = 40 
local WALL_HEIGHT = 12
local WALL_THICKNESS = 1
local RENDER_DISTANCE = 3 

local generatedChunks = {} 
local backroomsFolder

-- 1. PEMBERSIHAN MAP LAMA & BASEPLATE
local function clearMap()
    debug.profilebegin("FastMapClear")
    local children = workspace:GetChildren()
    for i = 1, #children do
        local obj = children[i]
        if not obj:IsA("Camera") and not obj:IsA("Terrain") then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(obj) then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
    end
    debug.profileend()
    print("✓ Map lama dan Baseplate dipadamkan!")
end

-- Fungsi Matematik Deterministik Maze
local function getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, wallType)
    local seed = math.sin(chunkX * 12.9898 + chunkZ * 78.233) * 43758.5453
    local pseudoRandom = seed - math.floor(seed)
    if wallType == "North" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "West" then return pseudoRandom > 0.45 end
    if wallType == "CenterH" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    if wallType == "CenterV" then return pseudoRandom > 0.55 end
    return false
end

-- 2. PENJANAAN CHUNK
local function generateChunk(chunkX, chunkZ)
    local chunkKey = chunkX .. "," .. chunkZ
    if generatedChunks[chunkKey] then return end 
    generatedChunks[chunkKey] = true

    local chunkModel = Instance.new("Model")
    chunkModel.Name = "Chunk_" .. chunkKey
    chunkModel.Parent = backroomsFolder

    local worldX = chunkX * CHUNK_SIZE
    local worldZ = chunkZ * CHUNK_SIZE

    -- Lantai Karpet Kuning Lembap
    local floor = Instance.new("Part")
    floor.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    floor.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, -0.5, worldZ)
    floor.Color = Color3.fromRGB(185, 170, 115) 
    floor.Material = Enum.Material.Fabric
    floor.Anchored = true
    floor.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Siling Beton
    local ceiling = Instance.new("Part")
    ceiling.Size = Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, 1, CHUNK_SIZE)
    ceiling.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT + 0.5, worldZ)
    ceiling.Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 195, 180)
    ceiling.Material = Enum.Material.Concrete
    ceiling.Anchored = true
    ceiling.Parent = chunkModel

    -- Fungsi Dinding
    local function createWall(size, position)
        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Size = size
        wall.Position = position
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(215, 200, 130) 
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.Parent = chunkModel
    end

    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "North") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ - CHUNK_SIZE/2))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "West") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterH") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(CHUNK_SIZE/2, WALL_HEIGHT, WALL_THICKNESS), Vector3.new(worldX - CHUNK_SIZE/4, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ))
    end
    if getDeterministicWall(chunkX, chunkZ, "CenterV") then
        createWall(Vector3.new(WALL_THICKNESS, WALL_HEIGHT, CHUNK_SIZE/2), Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT/2, worldZ + CHUNK_SIZE/4))
    end

    -- Lampu Neon
    local lightPart = Instance.new("Part")
    lightPart.Size = Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 2)
    lightPart.Position = Vector3.new(worldX, WALL_HEIGHT - 0.1, worldZ)
    lightPart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 230)
    lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    lightPart.Anchored = true
    lightPart.Parent = chunkModel

    local pointLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
    pointLight.Brightness = 2
    pointLight.Range = 30
    pointLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 200)
    pointLight.Parent = lightPart

    if math.random() > 0.7 then
        task.spawn(function()
            while task.wait(math.random(3, 10)) do
                if not lightPart or not lightPart.Parent then break end
                pointLight.Enabled = false
                lightPart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic

        -- MENGALIS RENTIK: Membuat kedudukan X dan Z rawak (jejari 4 stud) di kawasan spawn

        -- Pindahkan watak dengan PivotTo ke udara
        character:PivotTo(CFrame.new(targetPosition))

        task.defer(function()

		for name, isOwned in pairs(owned) do

		local currentInfo = data[state.CurrentCutter]
		local keepCurrent = currentInfo and currentInfo.BestOwnedDamageBonus ~= nil

		for _, c in ipairs(candidates) do
			BuyCutterRF:InvokeServer(c.name)

			-- verify the purchase by re-reading the shop
			local newState = GetShopStateRF:InvokeServer()
			local bought = type(newState) == "table" and newState.OwnedCutters and newState.OwnedCutters[c.name]

	if not ok then warn("[AutoBuy error]", err) end

			local info = itemInfo(obj.Name)

local function updatePanel(found)
	if not (PicturesOn and PanelGui) then return end
	local hrp = getHRP()
	local count = math.min(#found, MAX_PICS)

	for i, row in ipairs(PanelRows) do
		local f = found[i]
		if f then
			local dist = hrp and math.floor((f.part.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude) or 0
			row.item = f
			row.frame.Visible = true
			row.name.Text = f.info.clean
			row.sub.Text = "#" .. f.info.num .. "  -  " .. dist .. " studs"
			row.btn.BackgroundColor3 = stateColor(f.root)
			if row.key ~= f.info.key then
				row.key = f.info.key
				setThumb(row.vp, f.root)
			end
		else
			row.item = nil
			row.frame.Visible = false
			row.key = nil
		end
	end

	PanelEmpty.Visible = (count == 0)
	applyPanelSize(count)
end

-- Collects queued items one at a time (green = collecting, blue = waiting)
local function processQueue()
	if PredictorBusy then return end
	PredictorBusy = true

	task.spawn(function()
		local hrp0 = getHRP()
		local startCFrame = hrp0 and hrp0.CFrame

		while #PanelQueue > 0 do
			while IsSelling do task.wait(0.2) end

			local q = table.remove(PanelQueue, 1)
			CurrentTarget = q.root
			updatePanel(LastScan)

			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				local hrp = getHRP()
				if not hrp then return end
				if not (q.root.Parent and q.part.Parent) then return end -- already gone

				tweenToCFrame(q.part.CFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
				task.wait(0.05)

				local prompt = q.root:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) or q.part:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				if prompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 0)
				firetouchinterest(hrp, q.part, 1)
				task.wait(0.1)
			end)
			if not ok then warn("[Predictor error]", err) end

			CurrentTarget = nil
			refreshPredictor()
		end

		if startCFrame and getHRP() then
			tweenToCFrame(startCFrame, TravelSpeed, sellingNow)
		end

		PredictorBusy = false
		refreshPredictor()
	end)
end

enqueueItem = function(f)
	if CurrentTarget == f.root or inQueue(f.root) then return end
	table.insert(PanelQueue, { root = f.root, part = f.part, info = f.info })
	updatePanel(LastScan)
	processQueue()
end
